name: Futari no Kon'yakusha
source:
Parents have prepared main heroine's engagement with one of two childhood friends. She returns to home town and starts living with the two of them to decide on the person to marry. There is also an option to choose someone entirely different, like a teacher or a cashier boy at the local shop.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母为女主角准备了婚约对象，对方是两名青梅竹马之一。她回到故乡，和两人一起生活，决定最终嫁给谁。她也可以选择完全不同的人，比如老师或当地商店的收银员。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndreview[/url]]
